units.source_text: 美国兵揪住女人，朝我曾了一眼，然后，轻轻地松开了揪住女人鲜红前襟的手。

en.t: The American soldier grabbed the woman, glanced at me, and then gently let go of the hand that had been clutching the bright red front of her coat.

units.source_text: 这只松开了的手的力量，似乎非同寻常。

en.t: The force of that released hand seemed extraordinary.

units.source_text: 女人被撂倒，四脚朝天地躺倒在雪地上。

en.t: The woman was knocked down and lay sprawled on her back in the snow.

units.source_text: 鲜红的大衣下摆掀开了，肌肤白皙的大腿摊在雪地上。

en.t: The hem of her bright red coat had flipped open, and her pale thighs were spread out on the snow.
